nodeScalars.method: Five fixed geometries, 256 and 400 pixels per side, unweighted and partial/zero-weight targets. Each case evaluates two orientations, both phases and three point arrays. Three alternating-order rounds after warmup. Weighted force fields are compiled once outside both timers, as in refinement. Current totals include preparing both orientation tables once and all 12 evaluations. Previous totals rebuild image integrals in all 12 calls. Every scalar and the one-call API must exactly match the previous source. Loading, fixtures and comparisons are outside the timers.

browserScalars.method: Five fixed geometries, 256 and 400 pixels per side, unweighted and partial/zero-weight targets. Each case evaluates two orientations, both phases and three point arrays. Three alternating-order rounds after warmup. Weighted force fields are compiled once outside both timers, as in refinement. Current totals include preparing both orientation tables once and all 12 evaluations. Previous totals rebuild image integrals in all 12 calls. Every scalar and the one-call API must exactly match the previous source. Loading, fixtures and comparisons are outside the timers.

initialScalarComparison.limitation: The first comparator compiled weighted force fields on every previous call. Production already compiles that field once, so these timings overstate the attributable saving. Final nodeScalars and browserScalars exclude that common work in both policies.

refinement.method: Identical 120-step refinement of fixed grids; infinite deadline. Complete outputs including controls and histories compared exactly, excluding paper-audit elapsed seconds.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

fallback.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

profiles.note: Isolated worker instrumentation wraps both implementations. Previous boundary.js and refine.js are served from 1ea762f; other dependencies are current and unchanged. Preparation and callback evaluation are recorded separately. These are individual profiling runs, not uninstrumented release timing.

limitations: Fixed-scalar batches and fixed-step refinement comparisons isolate equivalent work; full image fitting uses separate timed runs and may select different checkpoints near a deadline.
Browser readiness is the first visible enabled result button, not a paint timestamp. Worker round trips include transport and scheduling. Later artifact capture and writes are excluded.
Node preparation through validation/export limits exclude photograph decoding and the additional independent export-render replay.
Source masks and saved test geometry are fixed; saved curves are used only for isolated evaluator tests, never as seeds in fresh image workflows.
